en.html:
Ichijou stood fixed beside me.

Understandable.

Enoshima, yes, she had encountered it there. But this close, face to face? This should be the first time. With that abnormality right in front of her, not even trying to hide, how was she to breathe normally?

Different in what way? Different world only.

So alien. So impossible to understand. Something belonging to another dimension.

A warrior. Beyond a warrior. Both had to be said.

Words were not coming to me either.

I had come to Oyumi hoping for a clue to Silver Star's whereabouts. A clue. Not the actual thing, directly in front of me, like this.

We were doing compulsory statue duty. The silver-white warrior, meanwhile, was entirely at ease. A look at Ichijou—at Masamune. A small tilt of the head. Then those eyes returned to me.

Monster.

Aberration. Demon. Something no longer human.

Not human.

Hikaru Minato, sister of Kageaki Minato, had ceased to be human long ago.

Now that I had found it—

I had to bring it down.

No other way. If I meant to remain human and protect human beings, I had to cut down the sister who was no longer one.

I should have understood this already. At the latest, at Enoshima.

Yes. Once, I had made myself ready to kill her.

But.

Even now...

What came out of my mouth was the part that would not let go.

With such expectation in its voice, Silver Star asked me that. What had once been Kageaki Minato's sister.

That question.

Not a joke.
Not pretending to be wicked.
Not even teasing.

Sincerely. From the heart.

I understood then. Not one doubt was there in that thing.

So many massacres. Sitting among the remains of another one even now. Saying it had killed them not because they were enemies, but simply to kill.

And not even doubting it!

At least madness, I had wanted to believe. A terrible curse had made my sister mad.

She had denied it.

Perfectly logical, her explanation. If that had truly been where the madness began, surely she could not have faced it so plainly. Yet she had faced it and explained that I was wrong.

Call that madness also? I could.

But I already knew. That would only be me running away.

Useless running. It would dull the blade, nothing else.

The blade that had to cut down my sister.

I needed the opposite.

Face what was true.

　それは、刃を鈍らせるだけだから。
